technicalFacts.fact: Current pricing and knowledge-base documentation describe one day of dashboard-accessible API/database log history on Free. This is not a guarantee that all provider-held copies or all service logs are deleted after one day.
Edge Function invocation logs and request metadata are distinct from intentional application-body logging; account-level audit logging is also separate.
The public DPA describes covered data and processing arrangements; publisher-specific contract and transfer assessment has not been completed by this technical check.

The changelog schedules removal of four old TLS 1.2 CBC cipher suites from HTTP APIs from 10 November 2026 at the earliest; TLS 1.3 and modern TLS 1.2 GCM/ChaCha suites remain. No TLS restrictions were weakened.
